articles.title: Join Us in Harare for Zimbabwe Clean Energy Week 2026: Sponsor, Exhibit, Speak, Showcase Your Brand, Nominate or Attend

articles.title: Industry Leaders Assess India’s INR 14,500 Crore Push To Develop 92 GWh Energy Storage Capacity
articles.summary: India’s Cabinet approved a ₹14,500 crore VGF scheme to develop 92 GWh of grid-scale storage by FY2030-31, including pumped hydro, BESS and emerging technologies. The initiative aims to stabilize the grid, integrate renewables, attract private investment and promote domestic manufacturing through a 40% BESS content requirement.
